name: architecture-pack
description: 책임·불변식 소유권·모듈 경계·의존성과 변경 영향을 검토하는 근거 기반 아키텍처 리뷰.
scope: Architecture and maintainability of the requested system/change. No automatic redesign or whole-product audit.

members.when: Pin scope, code/deployment evidence and one shared investigation plan.
Inspect structural contracts, actual callers and concrete change/verification costs.
A boundary or refactor affects executable state or invariant behavior.
Characterization, test seams or regression evidence affect the architectural claim.
Public service/event/schema boundaries or compatibility are implicated.
Invariant ownership crosses persistent or concurrent writers.
Trust, tenant, authorization or sensitive-data boundaries are implicated.
Cross-service effects, retries or recovery boundaries affect the structure.
A structural choice affects a concrete scale/resource requirement.
Deployment topology or version coexistence affects the architectural claim.
Client lifecycle/state ownership or client-server coupling is in scope.
Verify findings and coverage even if no findings were produced.
Findings or decisions move to another agent/session, explanation or implementation; reuse the canonical evidence record.
The user asks for a visual/web explanation of the findings; a review request alone is insufficient.
